title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje, Fusha e Aviacionit
description_sq:
Shesim nje apartament 2+1 ne Zonen e Fushes se Aviacionit, ndertim ne faza perfundimtare punimesh, 
Apartamenti ndodhet na katin e pare banim, me siperfaqe totale prej 99.39m2, planimetri e perzgjedhur me kujdes qe me nxjerrjen e lejes se ndertimit
Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori shperndares salloni ndenjes me dalje ne ballkon,2 dhoma gjumi nje tualet
pamje nga rruga kryesore. Faza e ndertimit ne proces suvatime te brendshme 
Eshte ideale si per banim ashtu dhe investim.
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment in the Aviation Field Area, construction in the final stages of construction, the apartment is located on the first residential floor, with a total area of ​​99.39m2, the floor plan has been carefully selected since the issuance of the building permit. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with access to the balcony, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom overlooking the main street. The construction phase is in the process of internal plastering. It is ideal for both residence and investment.
